article.headline: Cameron Shockley-Okeke, Marcus Dockery lead Howard over Maryland Eastern Shore 77-57
article.description: — Cameron Shockley-Okeke and Marcus Dockery scored 18 points apiece to lead Howard to a 77-57 victory over Maryland Eastern Shore on Monday night.
article.linkText: Cameron Shockley-Okeke, Marcus Dockery lead Howard over Maryland Eastern Shore 77-57
article.story: PRINCESS ANNE, Md. -- — Cameron Shockley-Okeke and Marcus Dockery scored 18 points apiece to lead Howard to a 77-57 victory over Maryland Eastern Shore on Monday night. Shockley-Okeke shot 6 for 12, including 5 for 11 from beyond the arc for the Bison (10-14, 5-2 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Dockery made 7 for 10 shots (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line. Blake Harper had 13 points. Ketron Shaw had 25 points and four steals to lead the Hawks (4-19, 0-7), who have lost eight in a row. Chris Flippin had 12 points and Evan Johnson scored 10. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
